title: Józef Chełmoński, Storm, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description The latest issue in the series dedicated to the art of Józef Chełmoński, master of Polish realism. One of his most dramatic works comes to life on a silver coin, in which the artist masterfully captured the moment a violent storm surprises shepherds and a herd of cattle in an open field. The entire composition is bursting with tension and dynamism, and thanks to precise digital printing, it has been possible to render the sheer power of the elements that is the essence of this painting’s strength.
